description:
The process begins when a company identifies the need for a new supplier or vendor.
The procurement team issues a request for proposals (RFP) and receives responses from various suppliers.
Each proposal is evaluated based on criteria like cost, quality, and delivery time.
The team may also conduct site visits or interviews with suppliers.
After careful analysis, a supplier is selected, and contract negotiations begin.
Once both parties agree on the terms, the contract is signed.
The process ends when the supplier is officially onboarded, and the contract is executed.

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_OnboardSupplier</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ExecuteContract</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_CompletionJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Complete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Procurement" name="Procurement team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_IssueRFP</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveProposals</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EvaluateProposals</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AssessmentSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ConductSiteVisit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ConductInterview</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AssessmentJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AnalyzeAndSelect</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NegotiateTerms</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AgreeTerms</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SignContract</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_SupplierNeed" name="Need for a new supplier identified"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IdentifyNeed" name="Identify need for a new supplier"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_IssueRFP" name="Issue request for proposals" messageRef="Message_RFP"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveProposals" name="Receive supplier proposals" messageRef="Message_Proposal"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EvaluateProposals" name="Evaluate each proposal">
      <bpmn:documentation>Evaluate proposals based on cost, quality, and delivery time.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AssessmentSplit" name="Conduct optional supplier assessments" default="Flow_AssessmentNone"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConductSiteVisit" name="Conduct site visits with suppliers"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConductInterview" name="Conduct interviews with suppliers"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AssessmentJoin" name="Join assessment paths"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AnalyzeAndSelect" name="Analyze proposals and select supplier"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateTerms" name="Negotiate contract terms"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AgreeTerms" name="Agree on contract terms"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SignContract" name="Sign contract"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CompletionSplit" name="Complete onboarding and contract execution"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OnboardSupplier" name="Officially onboard supplier"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ExecuteContract" name="Execute contract"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CompletionJoin" name="Join completion"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Complete" name="Supplier officially onboarded and contract executed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Identify" sourceRef="Start_SupplierNeed" targetRef="Task_IdentifyNeed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Identify_IssueRFP" sourceRef="Task_IdentifyNeed" targetRef="Task_IssueRFP"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IssueRFP_Receive" sourceRef="Task_IssueRFP" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProposals"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Receive_Evaluate" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveProposals" targetRef="Task_EvaluateProposals"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Evaluate_Assessment" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateProposals" targetRef="Gateway_AssessmentSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AssessmentSiteVisit" name="Site visits" sourceRef="Gateway_AssessmentSplit" targetRef="Task_ConductSiteVisit">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Site visits are conducted</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AssessmentInterview" name="Interviews" sourceRef="Gateway_AssessmentSplit" targetRef="Task_ConductInterview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Interviews are conducted</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AssessmentNone" name="No additional assessment" sourceRef="Gateway_AssessmentSplit" targetRef="Gateway_AssessmentJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SiteVisit_Join" sourceRef="Task_ConductSiteVisit" targetRef="Gateway_AssessmentJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Interview_Join" sourceRef="Task_ConductInterview" targetRef="Gateway_AssessmentJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Assessment_Analyze" sourceRef="Gateway_AssessmentJoin" targetRef="Task_AnalyzeAndSelect"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Analyze_Negotiate" sourceRef="Task_AnalyzeAndSelect" targetRef="Task_NegotiateTerms"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Negotiate_Agree" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateTerms" targetRef="Task_AgreeTerms"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agree_Sign" sourceRef="Task_AgreeTerms" targetRef="Task_SignContract"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Sign_CompletionSplit" sourceRef="Task_SignContract" targetRef="Gateway_CompletionSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Completion_Onboard" sourceRef="Gateway_CompletionSplit" targetRef="Task_OnboardSupplier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Completion_Execute" sourceRef="Gateway_CompletionSplit" targetRef="Task_ExecuteContract"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Onboard_CompletionJoin" sourceRef="Task_OnboardSupplier" targetRef="Gateway_CompletionJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Execute_CompletionJoin" sourceRef="Task_ExecuteContract" targetRef="Gateway_CompletionJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompletionJoin_End" sourceRef="Gateway_CompletionJoin" targetRef="End_Complete"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_SupplierSelection">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company" processRef="Process_SupplierSelection"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Suppliers" name="Suppliers"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RFP" name="Request for proposals" sourceRef="Task_IssueRFP" targetRef="Participant_Suppliers" messageRef="Message_RFP"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Proposal" name="Supplier proposals" sourceRef="Participant_Suppliers" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProposals" messageRef="Message_Proposal"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
